title: Does More Disclosure Track Fewer Reported Incidents? A Correlational Probe

original_idea.body: Does More Disclosure Track Fewer Reported Incidents? A Correlational Probe

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Testing the transparency-improves-safety assumption is valuable but confounded; chain to catastrophic risk has a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Join public scores with incident data + simple correlational stats; beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused correlational deliverable; data joining and confounders add some scope.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Diffuse fuzzy-reward analysis labs won't produce; public data only.

novelty.reasoning: The disclosure-vs-incidents correlation appears unexamined empirically.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Both datasets exist; this specific correlational join may be open.
